description:
Hushfacebook 0.1.6 makes settings easier to scan. Actions stand out more clearly in dark and light themes, and the recovery screen has more distinct controls. Shorter descriptions in all five translations keep the important exceptions. Pause has a visible badge when active.

The Save folder dialog explains where files go and confirms the saved name when characters need replacing. The diagnostic choices explain quick and full reports. The Licenses screen wraps notices for a phone and makes project links tappable.

All 21 patches applied without force to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, with no manifest changes. Local checks passed: 389 extension tests, 115 patch tests and both Android lints. Signed-in feed and Story checks remain pending on an isolated test session.

Requires Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a Facebook bundle. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK.
